paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Error rate for slots
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the error rate distribution across various slots in a dialogue state tracking system, as reported in the paper "Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation." The chart is divided into 14 distinct segments, each representing a different slot type and its corresponding error rate. The largest segment, colored green, corresponds to the "date" slot with an error rate of 19.30%, followed by the "from" slot (light blue, 17.00%) and the "to" slot (yellow, 14.50%). The "genre" slot (dark green) accounts for 13.50% of the errors. Smaller segments include "name" (5.20%), "size" (4.20%), "time" (4.10%), "intent" (3.80%), "location" (3.80%), "destination" (3.00%), "city" (2.60%), "class" (2.40%), "range" (2.20%), "type" (2.00%), "beds" (1.30%), and "passengers" (1.10%). Each slice is labeled with its category and percentage, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-right, with the largest segments positioned prominently. The chart does not include a legend, as labels are directly connected to their respective slices via lines.
